result.description: A fictional 27-inch professional display designed for color-critical studio work, remote collaboration, and high-resolution content review. The Halo 27QXL features a matte IPS panel, 2560x1440 resolution, USB-C docking, and an integrated ambient light sensor for consistent viewing in mixed lighting environments. It is positioned as a monitor rather than a storage or graphics product, with emphasis on visual workflow and desk integration.
